annotations.title: List which of a workflow's steps something could do

description: Your earlier read of a WORKFLOW's steps: for each suggestion, the steps it covers (nodeIds, labels), what could do them (proposal.doer: a flow and its mode, a shim, or a task), whether it does the step or helps (reach), why, and what it would take (checklist, each item met or not). state OPEN is waiting for a person; APPLIED made a change (opportunityId), and `built` is what was built for it in Workbench, if anything. Pass changeId instead of pageId to get the one suggestion a change came from. To build one, use compass_step_suggestions_build — not workbench_flows_scaffold.

changeId.description: A change (opportunity) id: the suggestion it came from.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
